comment: Per-file type error counts for `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json`.
**`typecheck:tests` is clean: 0 errors across 0 files, so `files` is empty.** The ratchet is at its
- a file absent from this list must have ZERO errors (a new failure is blocked anywhere)
- a file present must not EXCEED its recorded count (improvement is always allowed)
This file began as a ratchet against a red tree — 1829 errors across 184 files — and the per-file shape is
what let it be worked down without a clean file going dirty when another improved. With the backlog at zero,
the mechanism now only guards the result.
A file that must stay below the threshold has a different home: `scripts/coverage-per-file-exclusions.json`.
To record a genuine improvement, re-run the gate with --update; the numbers should only ever tighten.
